chunks: O my father, to me has come such knowledge as never came to you. So follow me that I may show you the right path.
ai.seo_question: What did Yahya say to his father Zakariyya regarding the knowledge he received?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Yahya (John the Baptist) addresses his father, Zakariyya, claiming to have received divine knowledge and prophethood that his father did not, inviting him to follow the straight path. While classical Shia exegesis often identifies this speaker as Yahya, some scholars suggest it may refer to Jesus (Isa) or even be a general address to the Children of Israel, highlighting the transmission of divine wisdom across generations. The verse underscores the theme of divine guidance being bestowed upon the righteous, regardless of familial lineage, and serves as an invitation to accept prophetic truth.
